description: Complete homepage visual reconstruction - rebuild the LandingPage to a premium, memorable, globally competitive level. Transform the hero section into a cinematic full-bleed experience with layered gradient backgrounds, a floating 3D card showcase (replacing the static campus photo), animated particle effects, and a dramatic typography hierarchy. Rebuild the features bento grid with richer card interiors (illustrations, gradient meshes, subtle animations). Add a new social proof / trust bar section. Enhance the AI showcase with a more dynamic chat simulation. Rebuild the final CTA with premium depth effects. All while preserving content, RTL, and routing.
steps: Step 1: Rebuild LandingPage.tsx hero section - Replace the campus photo figure with a premium animated showcase: a floating card stack showing 3 mock dashboard screens (GPA card, AI chat bubble, learning path card) that rotate/float with CSS transforms. Add a large gradient mesh background behind the hero using CSS (radial gradients layered with noise texture). Make the hero title use a split-line animated reveal with clip-path or translateY stagger per word. Keep the CTA buttons but upgrade them to have a glass morphism container behind them.

Step 2: Create a new CSS file frontend/src/styles/redesign-landing.css that will hold all the rebuilt landing styles. Import it in the main CSS entry. This avoids conflicting with existing landing.css/premium.css - it loads AFTER them and overrides. Include: hero gradient mesh (3+ layered radial gradients with blend modes), floating card showcase animation (3D perspective transforms, staggered float keyframes), particle dot grid (using repeating-linear-gradient or radial-gradient patterns), enhanced section transitions.

Step 3: Rebuild the features bento grid cards in LandingPage.tsx - Each card gets a subtle inner gradient mesh (unique per card based on data-tone), a larger icon with animated glow ring on hover, and the card body gets better typographic hierarchy with a sub-label. The wide cards get an illustrative gradient background (abstract shapes via CSS). Add hover state: card lifts 6px, inner gradient intensifies, border glows with tone color.

Step 4: Add a new 'Trust Bar' section between features and AI showcase in LandingPage.tsx - A horizontal strip with animated logos/icons representing: University partnership, AI-powered, secure platform, 50K+ users. Use Lucide icons with animated entrance. Style with glassmorphism container, subtle glow effects.

Step 5: Rebuild the AI showcase section - Make the chat preview more dynamic: add a simulated typing animation (CSS only), make the avatar pulse with an animated gradient ring, add floating code/math symbols around the section (CSS pseudo-elements with position absolute). The text column gets a gradient heading and animated bullet list entrance.

Step 6: Rebuild the pilot results section - Each stat card becomes a 'radial stat' with a circular progress ring (CSS conic-gradient) behind the percentage value, animated on scroll. The highlight card gets a prominent gold glow treatment.

Step 7: Rebuild the final CTA section - Make it feel like a premium full-bleed surface: layered noise texture + gradient + floating geometric shapes (triangles, circles via CSS). The CTA container gets a prominent glass card with depth shadow. Add subtle animated scan-line effect across the background.

Step 8: Enhance mobile layout - Ensure the floating card showcase stacks to a single card on phone with swipe hint. Bento cards go single-column cleanly. Trust bar wraps to 2x2. Hero title respects phone sizing. All animations reduced on phone for performance.
Step 9: Update frontend/src/styles/responsive.css with any needed landing mobile overrides for the new layout.
Step 10: Ensure all new animations have prefers-reduced-motion fallbacks in the new CSS file.
acceptance_criteria: All new CSS has balanced braces (no syntax errors)
Hero section uses layered gradient background with animated showcase (not just a static photo)
Bento feature cards have unique gradient treatments per tone
New Trust Bar section is present between features and AI section
AI showcase has animated typing indicator and gradient avatar ring
Pilot stats use conic-gradient or similar circular progress visualization
Final CTA has depth layers (noise, gradient, floating shapes, glass container)
All animations include prefers-reduced-motion: reduce fallback
Mobile breakpoints (900px, 640px, 480px) produce clean single-column layouts without overflow

All changes validated via: CSS brace balance check (passed), TSX bracket/paren balance check (passed), import presence verification (passed).
